items.title: John Ternus has the 'Apple DNA' that will push company to the 'next level'
items.summary: CFRA Research senior vice president Angelo Zino discusses why new Apple (AAPL) CEO John Ternus may be the right man for the job, especially after the release of the new iPhone 18 Pro and unveiling of the foldable iPhone Duo.

items.title: Apple will essentially sell 'every single' iPhone Duo it makes: CFRA
items.summary: Apple's (AAPL) iPhone 18 Pro has hit store shelves on Friday, coming out a full month before the foldable iPhone Duo's release in late October. CFRA Research senior vice president and equity analyst Angelo Zino comes on Market Domination to discuss his forecast surrounding demand for the foldable iPhone.
